binary_target.HEAVY_RAIN: next-day rainfall at or above 50 mm

feature_engineering.historical_lag: prcp_lag1_mm is precipitation shifted one observation within each station
feature_engineering.rolling_windows: 3/7/14-day precipitation means use prcp shifted by one observation, independently per station
feature_engineering.target: next observation only when it is exactly one calendar day later; invalid consecutive-date target rows excluded
feature_engineering.missing_prcp: missing target observations excluded; missing feature values are median-imputed by the ML pipeline; missing values are never converted to zero

chronological.method: unique-date chronological 60/20/20 split; all stations included on each date
